The '''2019 Ryloth Regionals''' were the Netherlands and Belgium regional championship, held on 4 May 2019 at the Thiemeloods in Nijmegen, Netherlands. Eight players played six Swiss games with no final confrontation. [[Angelo Consoli]] won with Old Allies and Ralltiir Operations.<ref name="ryl19">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=71607 Ryloth Regional, Nijmegen, Netherlands: May the 4th (be with you!)], forum.starwarsccg.org (16 January – 11 May 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105004217/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t71607.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]] (post-reset Virtual Sets through Set 10, Demo Deck cards and Set 11 preview cards)<ref name="ryl19" />
* '''Site:''' Thiemeloods, Leemptstraat 34, Nijmegen<ref name="ryl19" />
* '''Date:''' 4 May 2019<ref name="ryl19" />
* '''Structure:''' 6 games Swiss (SoS), no final confrontation<ref name="ryl19" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Floris de Vries]]<ref name="ryl19" />
* '''Field:''' 8 players<ref name="ryl19" />
